access_model: Distribution-gated, not roster-gated. Anyone with the shared link may register free after proving email ownership.
acceptance_tests: Registration requires email verification but no member allowlist
Registration endpoint makes zero model calls
Verification codes are single-use and expire after 10 minutes
Email delivery is queued and never blocks the HTTP response
Queue depth and delivery failures are visible in sanitized logs
Beta-code path is preserved behind an environment flag
